title: Sedona City Council tells SPD and city staff to turn off Flock cameras - Sedona Red Rock News
summary: Sedona City Council, by majority consensus at an Aug. 13 special meeting, directed the Sedona Police Department and city staff to indefinitely turn off the city's 11 installed Flock ALPR cameras, which had not yet been activated. The council also directed staff to compile a history of the program, form a citizen work group, and return with a pilot program proposal.

key_quotes.quote: The Sedona Police Department's Automated License Plate Reader program with Flock Group, Inc. has been indefinitely shut off following a majority consensus of Sedona City Council members at a special meeting on Wednesday, Aug. 13
ALPR is not a mass surveillance tool; it is a focused, objective investigative asset governed by strict data retention policies and transparency protocols.
